scripts.dev:server: npm run build:server && tsx watch apps/server/src/index.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build --workspace @campus/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @campus/client
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:server && vitest run tests/unit
scripts.test:client: npm run build:server && vitest run tests/client
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run tests/integration
scripts.test:e2e:production: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.production.config.ts
